title: Bulkstream Hand-Built Hose Assembly
descriptionShort: Hand-built bespoke hose assemblies for ship-to-shore, ship-to-ship, chemical, and bulk-material transfer. Built to customer specification with rubber liner compounds matched to the application — fuels, oils, sea water, dry powders, sand, animal feed, abrasives.
descriptionLong:
The Bulkstream Hand-Built Hose Assembly (part code BULKSTREAM) is a Specialist & Custom-Built Hose from the Indus Hydraulics industrial hose range.

Application

Hand-built bespoke hose assemblies for ship-to-shore, ship-to-ship, chemical, and bulk-material transfer. Built to customer specification with rubber liner compounds matched to the application — fuels, oils, sea water, dry powders, sand, animal feed, abrasives.

Construction

  • Cover: Smooth or corrugated rubber cover
  • Lining / Tube: Rubber compound liner (NBR / EPDM / NR / SBR / CSM Hypalon / FPM Viton / CR Chlorobutyl per application)
  • Reinforcement: Hand-built textile / wire reinforcement (built-in or crimped ends)
  • Branding (printed on hose): Lloyd's Approval available; standard hoses upon request

Performance

  • Inner-diameter range: 51 mm to 1000 mm (NB: maximum length determined by mandrel length of relevant bore size)
  • Max working pressure: 3.5 bar to 40 bar
  • Min burst pressure: Per BS EN 1765 (ship-to-shore/ship-to-ship) or EN 12115 (chemical)
  • Min bend radius: Per assembly drawing
  • Weight: Per assembly drawing
  • Operating temperature: -30°C to +150°C (depending on rubber compound)
  • Safety factor: 4:1

Family context

Hand-built and custom-engineered hose assemblies — Bulkstream rubber-compound hand-built hoses (51-1000 mm bore), heat-traced/jacketed hoses with electric heat-trace cabling, and GSM ball-joint armoured hoses for steel mill / foundry service.

How to order

Specify (a) the inner diameter from the size range, (b) the assembly length, (c) end-fitting requirements, and (d) any special requirements such as Lloyd's certification or third-party witness testing. Indus engineering will confirm the assembly drawing on the RFQ.

Companion products

Pair with matching couplings and accessories (Cam & Groove, Boss steam couplings, hose clamps, Holedall permanently-attached fittings, hose tags, and Spiral Hose Guard / Fire Jacket protective sleeves) — full range available on quote.

title: GSM Ball-Joint Armoured Hose
descriptionShort: GSM ball-joint armour protects hose against extreme heat, abrasion and kinking. Used in steel mills (water, oxygen, gas service in critical applications), foundries, mining. Stainless steel or galvanised steel armour with various fibreglass insulation layers for extreme heat resistance.
descriptionLong:
The GSM Ball-Joint Armoured Hose (part code GSM) is a Specialist & Custom-Built Hose from the Indus Hydraulics industrial hose range.

Application

GSM ball-joint armour protects hose against extreme heat, abrasion and kinking. Used in steel mills (water, oxygen, gas service in critical applications), foundries, mining. Stainless steel or galvanised steel armour with various fibreglass insulation layers for extreme heat resistance.

Construction

  • Cover: GSM ball-joint armour (stainless steel or galvanised steel) + fibreglass insulation layers
  • Lining / Tube: Inner hose per material conveyed (rubber, PTFE, or metal)
  • Reinforcement: Ball-joint armour with no interlocking parts (no bend restriction)
  • Branding (printed on hose): Per host hose + GSM armour spec

Performance

  • Inner-diameter range: Per host hose
  • Max working pressure: Per host hose
  • Min burst pressure: Per host hose
  • Min bend radius: Per host hose (no ball-joint restriction)
  • Weight: Per assembly
  • Operating temperature: Per host hose + armour insulation rating

title: Heat Traced / Jacketed Hose

Supplied with electrical junction box at one hose end. Bespoke heat-shrink and jacketed cover options available.

  • Branding (printed on hose): Per host hose
